report_topic: Performance Audit of Systems and Controls in Assessment and Collection of Revenue from Major Minerals
observations_summary: The audit found significant revenue leakage (₹22,392.51 crore) due to irregular mining lease grants/extensions, misreporting of mineral grades and ex-mine prices, non-verification of sales turnover, and production exceeding environmental clearances and mining plans. It also highlighted deficiencies in internal controls, laboratory functioning, check gates, and inspections.
